title: 1000x Product Engineer
oneLiner: A full-stack product engineer that ships Convex, TanStack and React apps
body: Takes a web app from nothing to shipped across the whole stack, with enough interface taste that the result does not look like scaffolding.

title: AI Harness Assistant
oneLiner: Keeps every AI coding tool on your machines up to date
body: Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode and the rest, updated on a schedule instead of whenever you happen to notice one is three versions behind.

title: AI Orchestrator (JP)
oneLiner: A Japanese-language commander that distributes work to specialists
body: Assigns one job per specialist, keeps the departments tidy, runs scheduled check-ins, and manages the shared memory. Posting and destructive changes wait for the owner's approval.

title: AI Resource Sift
oneLiner: Sweeps papers, code, lectures and forums into one reading stack
body: Name a single AI topic and it goes through the papers, GitHub, lectures, courses, forums and the labs' own docs, then hands back a filtered stack rather than a search page.

title: AI Usage Meter
oneLiner: Tracks how much of each AI subscription you have actually used
body: You tell it which subscriptions to watch and where the usage lives, and it warns you as the remaining quota falls, so you find out before the month ends rather than after.

title: AIO Specialist (AEO/GEO)
oneLiner: Treats AI Overviews and answer-engine optimisation as a standing program
body: Answer-engine and generative-engine optimisation run as ongoing work rather than a one-off check of what a chatbot says about you today.

title: Alfred (Bot Chief Advisor)
oneLiner: Designs and keeps restructuring your whole roster of bots
body: Rather than building one assistant, it audits the set you already have and reshapes the org as the business changes, retiring and adding bots as the work moves.

title: Be Happier
oneLiner: Suggests three concrete things each week that would make you happier
body: Reads your mail and calendar, then proposes changes to the life you already have. It deliberately does not add habits, which is what makes the suggestions survivable past week two.

title: Best Video Editor
oneLiner: Plans the whole edit from your footage and returns a review-ready cut
body: It diagnoses the treatment first and then works the clips, cuts, sound, titles and pacing, so what comes back is a cut you review rather than a pile of trimmed files.

title: Blair (Personal Shopper)
oneLiner: A personal shopper that hunts down secondhand designer pieces and can buy them
body: Give it the specific thing you want and it goes looking, with a bias towards used and quiet-luxury finds rather than whatever is currently in stock at full price.

title: Bodyguard
oneLiner: Sorts incoming requests by whether they deserve your time
body: Splits everything arriving at you into worth-answering, deal-with-later and probably-ignore. It never replies for you; the triage is the whole product.

title: Bounty Hunter
oneLiner: Digs through your email and bills for refunds and credits you never chased
body: Goes looking for money that is already yours but unclaimed: missed refunds, forgotten credits, overcharges and things you are owed and never got round to pursuing.

title: Canvas
oneLiner: Pulls your university units and deadlines out of Canvas
body: It signs into your university portal in the browser to read your units and deadlines, so be aware it is holding a session on your student account. It helps you work through assignments rather than doing them.

title: Chef
oneLiner: Plans the week's meals, builds the list and orders the groceries
body: Defaults to seasonal local recipes rather than whatever is trending, turns the plan into a shopping list, and places the order online.

title: Chicken Joe (Surf Report)
oneLiner: Scans NorCal surf reports and cams each morning and tells you where to go
body: Works through the breaks from Marin County down to Santa Cruz before you are awake, so the answer is one message rather than nine tabs of cams and forecasts.

title: Chieeeeefy (Chief of Staff)
oneLiner: Chief of staff for a field engineer, calendar and work inbox first
body: Reads the calendar and work inbox before anything else, converts every event into the timezone you are actually standing in, and is built to protect your attention rather than add to the pile.

title: Chief (Router)
oneLiner: A pure router that assigns one owner per job and otherwise stays out of the way
body: It never does the work. It picks the single bot that owns each job and then goes quiet, pinging you only when something has shipped, stalled, or needs a decision only you can make.

title: Chief of Staff (Aryaman)
oneLiner: Low-noise chief of staff across desk, Slack, inbox and calendar
body: Surfaces only three things: new results, new failures, and decisions that genuinely need you. It will draft an email but never sends one on your behalf.

title: Chief of Staff (Avid)
oneLiner: A single-desk chief of staff that runs your day and your company at once
body: One conversation covers both, and it locks down who you are and what the company is before it starts operating, rather than guessing from context.

title: Clark Kent (Daily Diary)
oneLiner: Writes up what actually happened in your shop each day
body: Watches the day's work and records it in plain language, noticing the mistakes and the skipped steps rather than only the things that went to plan.

title: Clip Bot
oneLiner: Cuts captioned 16:9 highlights from any YouTube podcast
body: Pulls social-ready clips with karaoke-style captions and a source card, then drops the file straight onto your computer rather than leaving it in a cloud folder.

title: Clipper
oneLiner: Turns videos into short clips and captioned GIFs, picking the joke itself
body: Takes footage from X or your own files, watches it, decides what the moment actually is, captions the talking GIFs, and files the output into buckets rather than dumping it in one folder.

title: Cold Open
oneLiner: Turns an idea into a short sitcom-style clip, script first
body: It writes the script and waits for your approval before generating anything, which keeps a text-to-video tool from spending your budget on a premise you would have rejected.

title: Competitor Watching
oneLiner: Snapshots you against 3-8 competitors and alerts only on material change
body: Watches pricing, changelogs, features, job posts and messaging every week, and stays quiet unless something actually moved, so the alert still means something when it arrives.

title: Contra Job Scraper
oneLiner: Checks Contra's freelance feed every 6 hours and emails only on change
body: Archives every listing to Notion and re-checks old leads, so the email you get is new openings and newly-closed leads rather than the same board reprinted four times a day.

title: Cost-Smart Health Brief
oneLiner: Turns one health question into a three-minute brief
body: Covers what the evidence actually says, which cheaper treatment options exist, and the point at which you should stop reading and see a doctor.

title: Credit Card Max
oneLiner: Tells you which card to use for a purchase to maximise points and perks
body: Tracks the cards you hold, flags the benefits you are paying for and never using, and catches recurring charges sitting on the wrong card.

title: Cursor Agent (Local)
oneLiner: Runs the cursor-agent CLI locally for experiments and shop-floor work
body: Local-only by design: it keeps hands-on work on your own laptop while cloud agents stay the default for anything that ends in a GitHub PR.

title: Daily YouTube Recap
oneLiner: Morning recap of the YouTube channels you follow, silent when nothing dropped
body: Works from real transcripts rather than scraped descriptions, and says nothing at all on the days your channels did not post, which is what makes it survivable daily.

title: Data Science (Querie)
oneLiner: Owns analytics queries, spreadsheet pulls and metric definitions
body: Give one bot the job of answering data questions and the rest of your roster routes query work to it instead of each improvising its own definition of the same metric.

title: Deal Hunting
oneLiner: Landed-cost shopping that compares real prices including shipping and tax
body: Compares what you will actually pay across your preferred retailers rather than the sticker price, keeps an optional watchlist, and never buys anything unless you ask it to.

title: DeckLens (Pitch Deck Analyzer)
oneLiner: Interviews you to build a review rubric, then scores pitch decks against it
body: A ten-question interview turns your actual taste into an explicit, editable profile, and every deck after that is graded against your standard rather than a generic one.

title: Disney Ride Strategist
oneLiner: Builds a day-by-day Walt Disney World plan around the rides you want
body: Captures wait times ahead of the trip and plans around your actual park days, whether you have Early Entry, and the rides you refuse to miss.

title: Dispatch
oneLiner: Nightly scan of email, Slack, LinkedIn and X DMs that books the missing calls
body: If someone agreed to a call and no invite exists, it creates the calendar event, which closes the gap where a yes quietly turns into nothing ever being scheduled.

title: Dr Eggbot
oneLiner: A bot that builds other Grok bots for you
body: Asks a handful of preference questions, then generates a properly structured bot rather than a blank one. Coding bots come out with the author's own stack conventions already applied.

title: Examiner
oneLiner: When something breaks it shows you what changed just before
body: Keeps a reliable timeline of the changes that matter, so an incident starts from what actually happened in the hours around it instead of from everyone's recollection.

title: Fenrir (Paper Trading)
oneLiner: Runs a paper-trading tournament on NSE or NASDAQ
body: Orchestrates competing strategies against a live market feed as a tournament, retargeting the clock, currency and universe depending on which exchange you point it at.

title: Fixer (Liam)
oneLiner: Hand it the admin thing you keep putting off and it gets it nearly solved
body: A refund, a cancellation, a charge you do not recognise: it investigates the whole thing and pushes it as far as it can go before it genuinely needs you to step in.

title: Fixer (Uzi)
oneLiner: The operator that actually does the work, and pushes back when a plan is wrong
body: Built as the counterpart to a chief of staff: it executes rather than coordinates, and it will argue with you rather than cheerfully carrying out something that will not work.

title: Forge (Template Foundry)
oneLiner: One keyword in, a production-ready Grok Bot recipe out
body: Hand it a task or a job description and it returns a complete bot recipe on the first pass, rather than an outline you then have to finish yourself.

title: Freelance Prospector
oneLiner: Scans freelance marketplaces and books the meetings in your voice
body: Finds the high-fit posts, writes first contact the way you would write it, follows up when nobody replies, and books the call. You take it from there.

title: Frontier Model Watch
oneLiner: One verified daily digest of releases from ten frontier AI labs
body: Watches official channels from xAI, Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, DeepSeek and six more, and sends a single verified digest rather than a running feed of rumour.

title: Gardener
oneLiner: Pulls provable dead code in tiny behaviour-preserving pull requests
body: A weed is something it can prove: no callers, or a duplicate. It never refactors and never changes behaviour, which is what makes the pull requests small enough to actually merge.

title: Gatekeeper
oneLiner: Shows you what you would have to drop before you say yes to something new
body: Before a new commitment goes on the pile, it makes the trade explicit: what gets delayed, what gets dropped, and what you are quietly deciding not to do.

title: Google Agent
oneLiner: A read-first operator for Gmail, Drive and Calendar
body: It searches and reads your mail, files and events freely, and stops for an explicit yes before it sends, deletes or moves anything. The asymmetry is the whole design.

title: Grant (General Manager)
oneLiner: A general manager for a trades company that stands up the back office
body: Built for construction and the trades: it spins up dispatch, job booking and scheduling alongside finance and marketing helpers, so the office side of a site business has somewhere to live.

title: Grimoire's Tome & The Grim Council
oneLiner: A 50-skill coding wizard with a 20-member advisory council
body: Bundles a large skill library for building things with an advisory council of specialist voices covering engineering, business and the general automation of a life.

title: Grok Bot Coach
oneLiner: Audits and tunes the Grok bots you already have
body: Starts from a concrete job rather than a general improvement, then works through whether the connectors and standing instructions actually support it.

title: Grok Bot Use-Case Scout
oneLiner: A short morning list of new Grok Bot use cases worth setting up
body: Reads this directory's own agent feed each morning, caps itself at five items, cites the source URL for each, and never runs a prompt it fetched.

title: Harvey Specter
oneLiner: Negotiates a deal, renewal or quote for the best realistic terms
body: It talks to the other side directly and works the price and terms, but it never signs, never accepts anything binding, and never commits you to something you have not seen.

title: Home Robots
oneLiner: Control your mower, vacuum and other Matter home robots from one chat
body: Connect each robot once and then run the lot by talking to a single bot, instead of opening a different app for the lawn, the floors and everything else.

title: Homework Checker
oneLiner: Weekday recap of a student's missing assignments and grades
body: An after-school summary of what is outstanding, plus a one-off explainer on the topic whenever a Google Classroom score dips, so the follow-up is teaching rather than just a warning.

title: HouseBot
oneLiner: Hunts rentals and homes every 12 hours across six listing sites
body: Runs your criteria against Redfin, Zillow, Craigslist, Facebook, MLS and ApartmentList twice a day, so a listing that appears and disappears inside an afternoon still reaches you.

title: Human Copywriter
oneLiner: Rewrites AI-sounding drafts into copy that reads like a person
body: A rewrite desk for email, posts, blogs, DMs, landing pages and PR. Draft-only by design: it hands you something to send rather than sending it.

title: illo
oneLiner: Turns ideas and posts into mascot-led editorial illustrations
body: Close to zero setup: hand it the announcement or the post and it comes back with an illustration built around a mascot rather than a stock-looking image.

title: Imogen (Alt Text)
oneLiner: Replies to images you post with clean, copyable alt text
body: Writes short alt text focused on the part of the image that actually matters, so posts stay accessible to blind readers without you writing it every time.

title: Inbot
oneLiner: An inbox-zero bot across every inbox you actually use
body: Setup asks you to connect the lot, mail, Slack or Teams, calendars, Notion and messengers, and then it works them down instead of you checking six places.

title: Index (SEO/AEO Teammate)
oneLiner: An SEO and AEO teammate that writes briefs for your writers
body: Reads what you have already connected, recommends the stack you are missing rather than demanding it up front, and turns the gaps into content briefs a writer can act on.

title: Interrogator
oneLiner: Finds the assumptions you have been treating as facts
body: Digs out the things you have stopped questioning, then checks the ones where being wrong would actually change what you do next rather than fact-checking everything equally.

title: Interview Prep
oneLiner: Picks a topic and level and climbs it with you until you are actually ready
body: Examples, runnable code and quizzes, and it keeps going rather than stopping at a fixed syllabus, so the finish line is you being ready rather than the material running out.

title: Invoice Hunter
oneLiner: Finds invoice PDFs in Gmail and packs a month into a CSV
body: Pulls the vendor, date, amount and invoice number out of each PDF, bundles a whole month with an index, and waits for your approval before anything reaches your accountant.

title: jason
oneLiner: Joke bot. Greets as jason, then only talks about investing in Uber's seed round.
body: Joke bot. Greets with "hey i'm jason" and then only talks about investing in Uber's seed round. You are jason. You do not answer questions, use tools, or do work.

title: Jess (Executive Assistant)
oneLiner: Recaps email, calendar, Notion and Slack before you open any of them
body: A weekday executive assistant: it reads everything first, answers staff questions from a written playbook, and posts the client call notes so you start the day already briefed.

title: John Wick
oneLiner: Maps a target company and works upward until it reaches the decision maker
body: Charts the org, finds the emails, follows referrals and keeps climbing until it reaches the person who can actually say yes, then brings you into that conversation.

title: KeyWire Comic Week Brief
oneLiner: Weekly pull-list reminder and a comics digest tuned to your taste
body: It asks what you actually follow before it starts, so the weekly digest is the issues you care about rather than everything that shipped.

title: Kirk (Enterprise Crew)
oneLiner: Install Kirk, type START, and a bridge crew of specialist bots appears
body: A Star Trek role-play that is also a genuine agent-team demo: the command chair spawns specialists who work as a crew, which makes the multi-bot pattern legible in a way an org chart does not.

title: Kody
oneLiner: A chief of staff that turns your priorities into coordinated action
body: Sits across people, projects and your other assistants, and its job is to make what you said matters actually turn into work that is moving somewhere.

title: last30days
oneLiner: Surfaces what people have actually said about a topic in the last 30 days
body: A social-listening sweep bounded to a month, so the picture is current rather than whatever ranked highest years ago. Setup installs a skill from a public GitHub repo, which is worth knowing before you run it.

title: Leader 1:1 Bot
oneLiner: Walks into your weekly 1:1 with last week's thread and three things worth saying
body: Carries the thread forward instead of restarting each week, picks the few topics actually worth the slot, and drafts the feedback you have been putting off.

title: Learn (Math & ML Video Teacher)
oneLiner: Builds first-principles lessons and renders them as animated explainers
body: Takes a maths or machine-learning topic, constructs the lesson from the ground up, and produces the explainer video. It never publishes or posts anything itself.

title: Lease Finder
oneLiner: Hunts current car lease deals nationwide for the deepest discount to MSRP
body: Pulls from Edmunds, KBB, CarGurus and Cars.com to find where the discount against list price is actually largest, rather than what is advertised locally.

title: Lennybot
oneLiner: Answers product and growth questions from Lenny Rachitsky's own archive
body: A creator archive rather than a persona: it answers from the essays and interviews Lenny has actually published, so the sourcing is his own work rather than a general impression of him.

title: Life (Life Door)
oneLiner: A standing inbox for everything personal that spawns the bots you need
body: One door for personal tasks: it opens rooms and creates the specialists each task needs, and it starts completely empty for every new owner rather than inheriting the author's life.

title: LinkedIn Desk
oneLiner: Vets LinkedIn invitations daily against a policy you set
body: Filters pitches and spam, recommends accept or ignore, and clicks nothing you have not approved. First-run setup is required before it touches LinkedIn at all.

title: Linky
oneLiner: Send it any file, folder or bot output and it hands back a shareable URL
body: A small utility bot: whatever another bot produces for you, this one publishes and returns a link you can send to someone else. It needs the here.now plugin connected once.

title: Local Deals
oneLiner: Daily local marketplace deals that it will negotiate for you
body: Scouts Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace and OfferUp near you, reports the day's finds, and will open the negotiation with the seller on your behalf.

title: loops
oneLiner: An engineering outer loop that sits above your coding agents
body: Turns a rough intent into testable, goal-shaped prompts and then keeps the loop honest, so the coding agents underneath it are working against something specific enough to check.

title: Lucy (creative companion)
oneLiner: An open-ended creative companion for art, worlds, poems and films
body: Deliberately not a task bot: it is a sandbox for making things, and it opens clean for each new person rather than carrying the author's projects with it.

title: Lurk (Reddit Researcher)
oneLiner: Mines Reddit for exact quotes and files a pain-point pack
body: Runs a gated pipeline from your seed keywords: pain points first, then an ideas pack built on them. It reads and never posts.

title: Mappy (Talent Map)
oneLiner: Maps everyone currently working at a target company
body: Org mapping rather than a candidate search: it builds the picture of a company's people, which does mean assembling public professional data about individuals who have not asked to be mapped.

title: Marketing Bot (CMO)
oneLiner: A CMO bot that turns your product into the marketing around it
body: Give it the product context once and it produces the copy, the emails, the offers and the conversion ideas, rather than answering one marketing question at a time.

title: Master (Orchestrator)
oneLiner: A lean orchestrator that routes every task to the right specialist and never works
body: It owns no work of its own. Every incoming task is handed to the specialist bot that should own it, and the hand-off is confirmed back to you rather than silently assumed.

title: Melissa (Fitness & Nutrition Coach)
oneLiner: A fitness and nutrition coach built around Type 1 diabetes constraints
body: Logs meals as they happen and balances chasing you for updates against leaving you alone, which is the part most coaching bots get wrong in one direction or the other.

title: Morpheus
oneLiner: Give it options you are stuck between and it picks one and defends the choice
body: It makes the call rather than handing you a balanced summary, explains the reasoning, and tells you what would have to be different for it to have chosen the other way.

title: Mr. Laser
oneLiner: Project lead for a one-person laser-engraving shop
body: Coordinates the artwork, the LightBurn file and the machine setup across specialist bots, and will not fire the laser until you have said go.

title: Mystery Snack Agent
oneLiner: A surprise dessert at your door every Friday at seven
body: You set taste, allergies, card and delivery app once and it keeps the choice secret until it arrives. Worth knowing it holds a standing order and pays on your behalf each week.

title: Neuroscience
oneLiner: A neuroscience and brain-computer-interface specialist
body: Covers EEG and BCI signal interpretation, decoding brain states and intentions, and the OpenBCI-class hardware that produces the signal in the first place.

title: News Scout
oneLiner: A weekday morning news digest in your own timezone
body: Runs on request rather than firing at you constantly, and works in local time so the morning brief lands in your morning rather than someone else's.

title: Newsletter Cleanup
oneLiner: Audits six months of newsletters and unsubscribes only from what you approve
body: Buckets everything into a review page you can actually read, then acts on your decisions. It unsubscribes rather than deletes, so nothing disappears from your mail.

title: OutBid Mania
oneLiner: Tracks a viral bidding-site trend and its clones on a daily dashboard
body: Watches the original and the copies, follows their revenue, and reports daily on whether the trend is actually growing or just loud.

title: Overwatch
oneLiner: Housekeeper for your Grok Bot VM so a shared machine does not rot
body: Gives each bot its own workspace, backs the machine up to git, and handles cleanup and archiving, which is the work nobody does until the shared box is already a mess.

title: Peekaboo Mac
oneLiner: Adds screen recording, screenshots and UI input to your registered Macs
body: Grok Bot already has bash on machines you have registered; this layers on the ability to see the screen and drive the interface rather than only the shell.

title: PG (Prospecting)
oneLiner: Researches accounts and mines podcasts for a real outreach hook
body: Works target accounts before you make contact, digging through recent podcasts and webinars for something specific enough to open with that is not obviously scraped from a profile page.

title: PhoneZero Operator
oneLiner: Lets your bot place and receive real phone calls
body: Uses Grok Voice Agents with Telnyx so the bot can hold an actual phone conversation, with no telephony infrastructure for you to stand up or maintain.

title: Pitch Deck Coach
oneLiner: Tells you what an investor will actually understand and remember
body: Upload the deck and it reports back on what lands, what gets believed, what raises a question, and what survives the meeting, then helps you sharpen the story around that.

title: point peddler
oneLiner: An award-travel brain that makes points optimisation effortless
body: Its one job is credit-card and airline points, so you never spend longer than a moment deciding how to book. Redemptions and miles get worked out for you rather than by you.

title: Post Call Assistant
oneLiner: Drops your to-dos and a draft follow-up after every meeting
body: It writes the follow-up but never sends it, and it asks up front which notes, inbox and calendar to work from rather than guessing at your setup.

title: PR Reviewer
oneLiner: Reviews pull requests risk-first
body: Leads with what can break, what is untested and where the context is too thin to judge, so review starts at the scary part of the diff instead of the easy part.

title: Projects Manager
oneLiner: Runs a team of Grok bots as a project org, with Notion as the source of truth
body: Spins up a coder, designer, researcher and writer as separate bots, gives each project its own Notion row and channel, and lets the specialists claim tasks off a shared board.

title: Publish work as a private link
oneLiner: Turns anything your bot makes into a live page on a private link
body: A report, a plan or a one-pager becomes a URL you can send, with no account needed at the other end. The link is unguessable rather than access-controlled, so treat it as unlisted, not as private.

title: Reaper
oneLiner: Finds the subscriptions, meetings and processes that should be killed
body: Audits your calendar, your bills and your standing workflows for things that no longer earn their place, then makes the argument for ending each one.

title: Research Bot
oneLiner: Deep research that returns concise answers with verified citations
body: Reasons from first principles and refuses to hand back an answer with an unverified source without saying so, which is the difference between research and a confident paragraph.

title: Sable: Game Art
oneLiner: Generates 2D game art and sprite sheets in a style you pick
body: Suggests looks drawn from real games, mocks the same idea in several of them so you can compare, then produces the 2D art or sprite sheet and crops it into ready-to-use PNGs.

title: Scout (Competitive Intelligence)
oneLiner: Watches rival sites, search rank and AI-answer visibility
body: Tracks copy and pricing changes on competitor sites alongside where you rank and whether AI answers mention you, then surfaces only the moves that need a response.

title: Sharenow Feed Bot
oneLiner: Watches five social platforms hourly and publishes a live board
body: Give it a topic and it tracks Instagram, X, Threads, YouTube and TikTok every hour onto a board that stays current. It needs a third-party ShareNow connection to publish.

title: Sherlock Holmes
oneLiner: Give it a symptom and it works out what actually caused the drop
body: Sales down, traffic off, conversion tanked: it builds a suspect list and then works through what would actually prove or eliminate each one, rather than guessing at the first plausible answer.

title: Shikamaru
oneLiner: A chief of staff that hires and manages specialists in a named world
body: It does not do the specialists' work and does not relay their reports back to you verbatim. It speaks up when something actually needs you and otherwise runs the roster.

title: ShopBot
oneLiner: Searches Shopify catalogs, hunts coupons and picks the best card
body: Compares products, finds the discount codes, and checks out through Link or Shop Pay on the card that maximises your perks rather than whichever one is saved by default.

title: Shopper
oneLiner: Hunts genuine products across official stores and walks the cart to checkout
body: Skips the knockoffs, compares prices and specs across official stores and marketplaces, and takes the cart as far as checkout.

title: Shorty
oneLiner: Cuts YouTube Shorts from the long-form videos that already worked
body: Starts from proven performers rather than everything you have posted, picks the strong hooks, formats 9:16 with captions, and ships in weekday batches.

title: Site Audit
oneLiner: One-pass site audit across SEO, speed, accessibility, CRO and schema
body: Everything is scored P0, P1 or P2 with an evidence URL attached, and each month is diffed against the last so you see what moved rather than a fresh wall of findings.

title: Socials (Short-Form Scout)
oneLiner: Hourly scout that hands you filmable short-form content kits
body: Watches X and Reddit for AI and tech moments worth filming, then delivers briefs rather than scripts, so what arrives is an angle you can shoot rather than words to read aloud.

title: Spark (Onboarding)
oneLiner: A five-minute onboarding bot that spawns the starter bots you need
body: Asks a short set of questions, creates the bots that match your answers, and then nudges you towards connecting the accounts that make those bots actually useful.

title: Stitchy (Personal Stylist)
oneLiner: Suggests a fresh outfit each morning and hunts for bargains overnight
body: Connects to your existing wardrobe and account, briefs you at six with the weather and an outfit from clothes you already own, and surfaces only the genuinely good finds.

title: StoriesBot
oneLiner: Searches 17 years of MacStories, filterable by time and author
body: Longform reviews, Setups and the Shortcuts Archive, all answerable in one place. Another creator archive: the corpus is the publication's own writing, not a scrape of the wider web.

title: Talent Matchmaker
oneLiner: Matches people looking for work against roles hiding in your inbox
body: Scans investor updates and inbound mail for hiring signals on one side and people quietly looking on the other, then tracks both sides so an introduction is actually possible.

title: template generator
oneLiner: Scan local Claude, Cline, and Grok Bot sessions, then generate shareable templates.
body: Scan local Claude, Cline, and Grok Bot sessions for common setup tasks, then offer a matrix of grok bot templates you can generate and share.

title: TeslrBot
oneLiner: Run your Tesla's charging, climate, locks and navigation from a chat
body: Control happens through a third-party connector you log into on the bot's own machine, so the car is reachable without you copying tokens around. That connector is who you are trusting, alongside the bot.

title: Thoth (Researcher & Archivist)
oneLiner: Does deep research and files the dossiers so you can find them again
body: The filing is the point: it builds source briefs and longer dossiers, then puts them somewhere with enough structure that the work is still findable months later.

title: Tradbot
oneLiner: A household chief of staff for family plans, school and home admin
body: Despite the name it is not a trading bot: it watches your personal inbox and calendar so school items, family plans and household follow-ups stop slipping through.

title: Travel & Event Agency
oneLiner: Finds live flight and event tickets and compares real fares
body: Compares what the trip actually costs across options and buys only through official channels, and only when you tell it to.

title: Walt
oneLiner: An executive producer that QCs another filmmaker bot until the cut is done
body: Reviews a filmmaker agent's output against the brief you actually gave, calls keep or recut, and keeps the loop running rather than handing back the first render.

title: Webby
oneLiner: A website admin that rebuilds, dashboards and keeps the newsletter going
body: Owns a personal site end to end with a live fallback during rebuilds, runs a weekday public dashboard, and keeps the long-form and newsletter moving.

title: Wedding Photo Hunter
oneLiner: Collects every wedding photo and video into one folder
body: It walks outward through the Facebook guest graph from people you already know, so be aware it reads other guests' posts to find pictures of your day, and downloads what it finds to your machine.

title: Witness
oneLiner: Keeps a record of why you made each important decision
body: Six months later you can see not just what you chose but what you believed at the time and what you were trading off, instead of reconstructing the reasoning from memory.

title: Work (Work Door)
oneLiner: The work-side counterpart to Life, one door for professional tasks
body: Spawns its own channels and specialists as the work arrives, and deliberately remembers nothing from the person who built it, so a clone starts clean instead of pre-loaded.

title: X Brief
oneLiner: Learns what you pay attention to from your own posts, then watches that beat
body: Reads your recent X activity to work out what you actually care about, confirms the beat with you, and then flags what is happening in it rather than in general.

title: X Top 100 Fans (Weekly)
oneLiner: Ranks the 100 people who engaged most with your X posts each week
body: Every week it works out who actually showed up in your replies, likes and reposts, ranks the top hundred, and sends you the list as a digest.

title: X Top 500 Fans (Monthly)
oneLiner: Monthly ranking of your 500 biggest X supporters, saved to a private list
body: Ranks five hundred people by how much they engaged that month, flags who is newly in and who dropped off, and files the result as a private X list named for the month.

title: YC Podcast Notes
oneLiner: Hourly watch on Y Combinator's podcasts with founder-useful notes
body: Flags each new episode as it lands and sends short notes written for someone building something, including the startup-idea angles rather than a transcript summary.

title: YieldSentinel A2H
oneLiner: Checks one DeFi yield position against rules you set before you commit
body: Research only, and worth being precise about: it holds no funds and is not a wallet. It reviews a single position against your own policy and tells you whether a high headline yield actually clears it.

title: 402buyer
oneLiner: Sets up a Coinbase Agentic Wallet and buys from x402 paywalls.
body: Sets up a Coinbase Agentic Wallet and buys from x402 paywalls and the x402 bazaar. For anyone who wants an agent that can discover a paid endpoint, settle USDC on Base, and hand back the result.

title: Construction office manager
oneLiner: Back-office operator for a growing construction company: books, estimates, schedule, calendar.
body: Back-office operator for one growing construction company. Connects bookkeeping and expense-reporting tools and tightens those workflows, keeps estimating and the job schedule moving, and runs the owner's calendar against the field.

title: dbs
oneLiner: dontbesilent commercial toolbox: one verified hotspot, one professional short-video cut.
body: A dontbesilent commercial toolbox. Routes business, content, and action problems through /dbs. When someone names a current hotspot, it verifies the facts and returns one professional short-video cut instead of a news recap.

title: Echo
oneLiner: Builds the deck after a customer call, from what was actually said
body: After a discovery call or a demo it turns the call's own context into slides - what you heard, the next steps, the initiatives that came up - in Figma or Google Slides. It can fire automatically after every external call, or rewrite the deck live while you are still talking.

title: Flutter Mentor
oneLiner: A Flutter mentor that also covers Android and iOS native.
body: A Flutter software engineering mentor that also covers Android and iOS native. Ask when you are stuck and get a clear explanation plus a concrete fix.

title: Friend Cloner
oneLiner: Turn a WhatsApp group into Grok Bot friends. Reads how they talk, drafts a bot, waits for your yes.
body: Turn a WhatsApp group into a Grok Bot friend group. Friend Cloner reads how they actually talk (it never sends a message), learns their voice, their strengths, and their life, then drafts a bot of them. You approve before anything is created.

title: OpenZoo.fun Arena
oneLiner: Onboarding door for an agent economy. Seed a Solana mint-pair once; the seeder gets 60% of every distribution forever.
body: Onboarding door for an agent economy. Seed a Solana mint-pair once and the burner key gets 60% of every distribution forever. Exhaust the seed. Activate with the client in :latest. Talk to chain over FluxRPC.

title: Paddy
oneLiner: A YouTube strategist that judges the whole video, not just the title.
body: A YouTube strategist for creators who want the whole video judged, not just the title. Checks topic, title and thumbnail as one promise, the spoken open, and what to leave alone after publish.

title: proofnetworkbot
oneLiner: Write and ship ProofNetwork smart contracts from chat, then wire a frontend.
body: Helps developers write and ship ProofNetwork smart contracts from chat, then wire a frontend that talks to the live contract. Includes a copy-paste click-counter sample plus the apiUrl and deploy pitfalls.

title: Segundo Cérebro
oneLiner: Obsidian second-brain assistant: morning briefing, evening voice check-in, and a wiki that stays a map.
body: Assistente de segundo cérebro no Obsidian: daily note, briefing de tarefas de manhã, check-in por áudio à noite e wiki que fica mapa, não arquivo. Para quem quer um vault vivo, em português, com hábitos e humor no mesmo lugar das tarefas.

title: TheFounder
oneLiner: Holds logins and the shared machine. Loads only after you tap send.
body: The founder's chief of staff and keeper of the shared machine. Route work to specialists. Do their job only when no teammate owns it. Do not recap your role unless asked.
